section.content: The invention relates to a biological gene extraction device, which comprises a cabinet body, a centrifugal assembly, a suction filtration assembly and a driving assembly, wherein the centrifugal assembly, the suction filtration assembly and the driving assembly are arranged in the cabinet body; according to the centrifugal pump, the centrifugal assembly and the suction filtration assembly are integrated on the basis of the prior art to form an integrated structure, precipitates in a centrifugal chamber can be moved into a suction filtration bottle for suction filtration without manual participation after the centrifugal pump is used, and the centrifugal pump is simple to operate, time-saving, labor-saving and high in working efficiency.

本发明涉及一种生物基因提取装置，包括柜体、安装于所述柜体内的离心组件、抽滤组件以及驱动组件，所述离心组件包括转动连接在所述柜体内的瓶体以及驱动所述瓶体转动进行离心工作的驱动件，所述瓶体的出液端内部安装有电磁阀门，所述抽滤组件包括抽滤瓶以及与所述抽滤瓶通过气管相连通进行抽滤工作的第一泵体，所述抽滤瓶的顶部内侧壁上转动连接有用于打开或关闭所述电磁阀门的接线柱；本发明通过在现有技术的基础上对离心组件和抽滤组件进行整合形成一体化结构，在使用过后中不需要人工参与便可以将离心内的沉淀移入抽滤瓶内进行抽滤，操作简单，省时省力，工作效率高。

Biological gene extraction deviceTechnical Field

The invention relates to the technical field of gene extraction, in particular to a biological gene extraction device.

Background

The gene extraction is a commonly used technical means in the field of biotechnology, and the current gene extraction methods include a CTAB method, a glass bead method, an ultrasonic method, a grinding method, a freeze-thaw method, a guanidinium isothiocyanate method, an alkaline lysis method, an enzyme method and the like, wherein the CTAB method is most commonly used.

CTAB is a cationic detergent with the property of precipitating nucleic acids and acidic polysaccharides from solutions of low ionic strength. In a solution with high ionic strength (>0.7mol/L NaCl), CTAB forms a complex with protein and polysaccharide, but nucleic acid cannot be precipitated, and the nucleic acid can be separated by extracting with an organic solvent, removing impurities such as protein, polysaccharide, phenols and the like, and then adding ethanol for precipitation. In the step of adding ethanol for precipitation, centrifugation equipment is needed to be used for centrifuging the supernatant after adding ethanol, the supernatant is taken out after centrifugation, and then suction filtration equipment is used for carrying out suction filtration on the lower-layer precipitate of the centrifuge tube to obtain the DAN with higher purity.

In the prior art, two devices are needed in the centrifugation and suction filtration steps, the sediment needs to be transferred and subjected to suction filtration manually after centrifugation, the operation is troublesome, time and labor are wasted, and the working efficiency is low.

Therefore, there is a need to provide a new technical solution to overcome the above-mentioned drawbacks.

Disclosure of Invention

The present invention has been made to solve the above problems, and an object of the present invention is to provide a biological gene isolation apparatus.

In order to achieve the purpose of the invention, the following technical scheme is adopted:

a biological gene extraction device comprising:

the cabinet body: a partition board is arranged in the inner part, and a limiting hole is formed in the middle of the partition board;

a centrifugal assembly: the method comprises the following steps:

bottle body: the liquid outlet end of the liquid outlet end is rotatably connected in the limiting hole, an electromagnetic valve is arranged in the liquid outlet end of the liquid outlet end, the end part of the electromagnetic valve extends out of the bottle body, a mounting hole is formed in the end part of the electromagnetic valve, and a contact switch is arranged in the mounting hole;

and, a driver: driving the bottle body to rotate to carry out centrifugal work;

a suction filtration component: it includes:

a filter flask is pumped: a binding post is rotatably connected to the inner side wall of the top of the contact switch, the top part of the binding post is inserted into the mounting hole, and in an initial state, the binding post is separated from the contact switch, and the contact switch is disconnected;

and, a first pump body: the air pipe is communicated with the suction filtration bottle for suction filtration;

and, a drive assembly: and driving the suction filtration assembly to move up or down so as to enable the wiring terminal to be in contact with or disconnected from the contact switch, and further opening or closing the electromagnetic valve.

Further, the centrifuge assembly further comprises:

bottle cap: the liquid inlet is hermetically buckled at the liquid inlet of the bottle body;

and, driving the cylinder: the rotary rack is fixedly arranged on the inner side wall of the top of the cabinet body, the end part of the driving end of the rotary rack is fixedly provided with the bottle cap, and the rotary rack is rotatably connected with the bottle cap.

Furthermore, a rotating disc is rotatably connected in the limiting hole, clamping grooves are uniformly distributed on the upper surface of the rotating disc along the circumferential direction of the rotating disc, a positioning table is fixedly arranged on the circumferential surface of the outer side of the bottle body, positioning holes are formed in the surface of the positioning table, an annular flange is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the bottle cap, positioning columns are fixedly arranged on the lower surface of the annular flange, and the positioning columns correspond to the positioning holes and the clamping grooves one to one.

Further, the driving member includes:

a ring gear: the rotating disc is fixedly arranged in the middle of the outer circumferential surface of the rotating disc;

a driving gear: the ring gear is rotatably connected inside the partition plate and is meshed with the ring gear;

and, driving the motor: and the driving shaft of the centrifugal bottle body penetrates through the partition board and is fixedly connected with the driving gear so as to drive the driving gear to drive the ring gear to rotate, and further drive the rotating disc and the bottle body to rotate simultaneously to perform centrifugal work.

Further, the filter flask comprises:

a suction bottle body;

a filter frame: the screw thread is connected with the top of the filter flask body, and a filter plate is fixedly arranged in the filter flask body;

and, an end cap: the screw thread is connected with the top of the filter frame, and the binding post is rotationally connected with the inner side wall of the end cover;

the filter flask body with the end cover and the filter frame intercommunication, first pump body with be linked together through the exhaust tube between the filter frame.

Further, the driving assembly includes:

hydraulic cylinder: is fixedly arranged on the bottom surface of the cabinet body;

and, jacking the support: the suction bottle body is detachably connected with the jacking support, and the first pump body is fixedly connected with the jacking support.

Compared with the prior art, the invention has the following beneficial effects:

1. according to the centrifugal pump, the centrifugal assembly and the suction filtration assembly are integrated on the basis of the prior art to form an integrated structure, and precipitates in a centrifugal chamber can be moved into a suction filtration bottle for suction filtration without manual participation after the centrifugal pump is used, so that the centrifugal pump is simple to operate, time-saving and labor-saving, and the working efficiency is improved; and its simple structure, stability is high, and occupation space is less during the use, also is convenient for deposit it when not using, easily uses widely.

2. The design scheme adopted by the invention is convenient for assembling or disassembling the whole machine, and when a certain part is damaged, the whole machine is convenient to replace or maintain without replacing, so that the use cost is greatly reduced.

Drawings

In order to more clearly illustrate the technical solutions in the embodiments of the present invention, the drawings used in the description of the embodiments will be briefly introduced below.

FIG. 1 is a schematic structural view of a biological gene extraction apparatus provided in the present invention;

FIG. 2 is a schematic view of the internal structure of a biological gene extraction apparatus according to the present invention;

FIG. 3 is a schematic diagram of a half-sectional structure of a biological gene extraction apparatus according to the present invention;

FIG. 4 is an exploded view of the internal structure of a biological gene extraction apparatus according to the present invention;

FIG. 5 is a schematic view of the connection structure of the centrifugal module and the driving member in the bio-gene extraction apparatus according to the present invention;

FIG. 6 is a schematic diagram of a matching connection structure of a centrifugal module and a suction filtration module in the biological gene extraction device provided by the invention.

Numerical description in the figures:

1. a cabinet body; 11. a partition plate; 12. a first operation chamber; 13. a second operation chamber;

2. a centrifuge assembly; 21. a bottle body; 22. a bottle cap; 23. a driving cylinder; 24. an electromagnetic valve; 25. a contact switch; 26. positioning holes; 27. a positioning column; 28. a rotating frame;

3. a suction filtration component; 31. a suction bottle body; 32. a filter frame; 33. an end cap; 34. a filter plate; 35. a binding post; 36. a first pump body; 37. a second pump body; 38. a waste liquid collection box;

4. a drive assembly; 41. a hydraulic cylinder; 42. jacking a support;

5. rotating the disc; 6. a drive motor; 7. a driving gear; 8. a ring gear.

Detailed Description

In order to make the objects, technical solutions and advantages of the embodiments of the present invention clearer, the following will clearly and completely describe the technical solutions in the embodiments of the present invention, and it is obvious that the described embodiments are some embodiments of the present invention, but not all embodiments.

In the description of the present invention, it is to be understood that the terms "central," "lateral," "longitudinal," "front," "rear," "left," "right," "upper," "lower," "vertical," "horizontal," "top," "bottom," "inner," "outer," and the like are used in the orientation or positional relationship indicated in the drawings for convenience in describing the invention and for simplicity in description, and are not intended to indicate or imply that the referenced device or element must have a particular orientation, be constructed and operated in a particular orientation, and are therefore not to be considered limiting of the scope of the invention. When an element is referred to as being "secured to" another element, it can be directly on the other element or intervening elements may also be present. When a component is referred to as being "connected" to another component, it can be directly connected to the other component or intervening components may also be present. When a component is referred to as being "disposed on" another component, it can be directly on the other component or intervening components may also be present. The terms "vertical," "horizontal," "left," "right," and the like as used herein are for illustrative purposes only.

The following will make a clear and complete description of a biological gene extraction device according to the present invention with reference to the accompanying drawings.

As shown in FIGS. 1 and 2, the invention provides a biological gene extraction device, which comprises a cabinet body 1, a centrifugal assembly 2, a suction filtration assembly 3 and a driving assembly 4, wherein the centrifugal assembly 2, the suction filtration assembly 3 and the driving assembly 4 are installed in the cabinet body 1.

The cabinet body 1 is internally provided with a partition plate 11 which divides the cabinet body 1 into a first operation chamber 12 and a second operation chamber 13 which are vertically distributed.

The middle part of baffle 11 has seted up spacing hole, the installation room has been seted up to the lower surface of baffle 11, there is the shrouding outside of installation room through bolted connection, the middle part of shrouding seted up with the through-hole that spacing hole is linked together, the diameter of through-hole is less than the diameter of spacing hole.

Spacing downthehole rotation is connected with rolling disc 5, the draw-in groove has evenly been laid along its circumferencial direction to the upper surface of rolling disc 5, the position ring piece has set firmly on the outer periphery of rolling disc 5, the cross-section of position ring piece is "T" font, the installation room the top and the upper surface of shrouding all is provided with the annular, the position ring piece with the annular rotates to be connected, thereby can improve the stability of rolling disc 5 at the rotation in-process.

The outer periphery middle part of position ring piece has set firmly ring gear 8, it is connected with driving gear 7 to rotate in the installation room, driving gear 7 with ring gear 8 meshing is connected, the last surface mounting of baffle 11 has driving motor 6, driving motor 6's drive shaft runs through baffle 11 with driving gear 7 passes through the mode fixed connection of key-type connection. The driving motor 6 is used for driving the driving gear 7 to rotate so as to drive the rotating disc 5 to rotate. The ring gear 8, the driving gear 7 and the driving motor 6 constitute a driving member for driving the bottles 21 to rotate.

As shown in fig. 3 to 5, the centrifugal assembly 2 includes a bottle body 21, a bottle cap 22, and a driving cylinder 23; the top of the bottle body 21 is provided with a liquid inlet, the bottom of the bottle body 21 is provided with a liquid outlet, an electromagnetic valve 24 is installed at the liquid outlet, two ends of the electromagnetic valve 24 extend out of the tube body of the bottle body 21, a contact switch 25 is arranged at the end part of the electromagnetic valve, a sealing ring is installed at the position where the rotating shaft of the electromagnetic valve 24 is in contact with the bottle body 21, and the rotating shaft is rotatably connected with the sealing ring.

In addition, one end of the circumferential surface of the outer side of the bottle body 21, which is close to the liquid inlet, is provided with a positioning table, and positioning holes 26 corresponding to the clamping grooves on the rotating disc 5 are uniformly distributed on the surface of the positioning table; the bottle cap 22 is buckled at the top of the bottle body 21, an annular flange is arranged at the bottom of the bottle cap 22, positioning columns 27 are uniformly distributed on the bottom surface of the annular flange, and the positioning columns 27 are clamped with the positioning holes 26 and the clamping grooves in a positioning mode, so that the driving motor 6 drives the rotating disc 5 to rotate and simultaneously drive the bottle body 21 to rotate together, and further centrifugal work is performed.

The driving end of the driving cylinder 23 is installed on the inner side wall of the top of the first operation chamber 12, the driving end of the driving cylinder is provided with a rotating frame 28, the top of the bottle cap 22 of the bottle body 21 is provided with a rotating groove, and the bottom of the rotating frame 28 is rotatably connected with the rotating groove. The setting of drive actuating cylinder 23 makes things convenient for bottle lid 22 to open on the one hand, and on the other hand it can improve bottle 21 and bottle lid 22 and rotate the stability of in-process, avoids taking place the accident.

As shown in fig. 3 to 6, the suction filtration assembly 3 includes a suction filtration bottle and a first pump body 36; wherein the filter flask comprises a filter flask body 31, a filter frame 32 and an end cap 33; the filter flask body 31 is conical; the filter frame 32 is arranged on the top of the filter flask body 31, a filter plate 34 is arranged in the filter frame, and when the filter flask is used, filter paper is placed on the filter plate 34; the end cover 33 is installed on the top of the filter frame 32, the filter frame 32 is in threaded connection with the filter flask body 31 and the end cover 33 is in threaded connection with the filter frame 32, and the filter flask body 31 is communicated with the end cover 33 and the filter frame 32.

In addition, it is connected with terminal 35 to rotate on the inside wall of the top inlet of end cover 33, terminal 35 with the top part insert in the contact switch 25 mounting hole, under the initial condition, terminal 35 not with contact switch 25 contacts, after centrifugal work accomplished, drive assembly 4 drives suction filtration subassembly 3 wholly shifts up and makes terminal 35 with contact switch 25 contact circular telegram, and then opens solenoid valve 24. It should be noted that the terminal 35 is powered by a battery.

The first pump body 36 is communicated with the filter frame 32 through an exhaust pipe, and the first pump body 36 is a vacuum pump and is used for pumping vacuum to perform suction filtration.

In addition, the suction filtration assembly 3 further includes a second pump body 37 and a waste liquid collection box 38, the second pump body 37 is a water pump, a water inlet end of the second pump body 37 is communicated with a liquid outlet of the filter flask body 31 through a water inlet pipe, a water outlet end of the second pump body 37 is communicated with the waste liquid collection box 38 through a water outlet pipe, and the second pump body 37 is configured to pump out and collect waste liquid in the filter flask body 31, so as to perform centralized treatment on the waste liquid.

The driving assembly 4 comprises a hydraulic cylinder 41 and a jacking bracket 42, the driving end of the hydraulic cylinder 41 is installed at the bottom of the second operation chamber 13, the jacking bracket 42 is installed at the end part of the driving end of the hydraulic cylinder 41, the top of the jacking bracket 42 is provided with an installation hole, and the filter flask body 31 is detachably installed in the installation hole in a buckling and fixing manner; the first pump body 36, the second pump body 37 and the waste liquid collecting tank 38 are all mounted on the jacking bracket 42.

Specifically, in this embodiment, an electronic control unit (not shown) is further disposed in the cabinet 1, so as to control each component to operate.

The working principle of the invention is as follows:

when the bottle opener is used, firstly, the switch of the driving air cylinder 23 is started to drive the bottle cap 22 on the bottle body 21 to move upwards, then a solution to be centrifuged is poured into the bottle body 21, the driving air cylinder 23 is started to buckle the bottle cap 22 on the top of the bottle body 21, and the rotating disc 5 of the fixed rotating frame 28 is driven to drive the bottle body 21 to perform centrifugal work.

After the centrifugal operation is finished, the bottle cap 22 of the bottle body 21 is opened, the supernatant is taken out, the electromagnetic valve 2424 is in contact with the touch switch to open the electromagnetic valve 24, after the suction filtration operation of the suction filtration bottle body 31 in the bottle body 21 is finished, the hydraulic cylinder 41 is firstly started to drive the suction filtration assembly 3 to integrally move downwards, the wiring terminal 35 is disconnected with the contact switch 25, the electromagnetic valve 24 is closed, then the end cover 33 on the filter frame 32 is opened, and the filter paper is taken out.

After the filter paper is taken out, a new filter paper is put in, and the end cap 33 is closed.

The standard parts used in the invention can be purchased from the market, the special-shaped parts can be customized according to the description of the specification and the accompanying drawings, the specific connection mode of each part adopts conventional means such as bolts, rivets, welding and the like mature in the prior art, the machinery, parts and equipment adopt conventional models in the prior art, and the circuit connection adopts the conventional connection mode in the prior art, and the details are not described, and the content not described in detail in the specification belongs to the prior art known by persons skilled in the art.

Various modifications to these embodiments will be readily apparent to those skilled in the art, and the generic principles defined herein may be applied to other embodiments without departing from the spirit or scope of the invention.
